steps.content: You come into the interrogation room. The young woman who is about to be interrogated is drumming her fingers on the armrest of her chair, impatience writ large on her face.
You put the evidence bag on the table. That's when her patience runs out.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I came all the way down here. And you locked me up in this messy room?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Sorry, but I don't have the time to tidy it up for you.
She sounds insincere and sardonic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nice to meet you, Uni.
You take a quick look around the room, with its spotless floor and walls and neatly arranged table and chairs. It could not, by any stretch of the imagination, be called messy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, this is an interrogation room. I don't think we should make it fancy, as long as it fulfills its purpose.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: This room lacks symmetry, is what I'm saying. The lighting, the furniture, even your haircut... It just makes my skin crawl.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Your eyes, though, are a different story. They're beautiful. Have you ever considered adjusting the other parts of your face to make them go better with those eyes?
The way she's looking at you...
It's an appraising look, as if you were a piece of furniture for sale. It has never left your face since you entered the room.

options: Are you speaking as a cosmetic surgeon?

choices.text: Are you speaking as a cosmetic surgeon?

steps.content: Uni is a cosmetic surgeon who owns an underground clinic. She is little known by the general public, but well known in certain Eastside circles.
She may be one of the wealthiest doctors in all of Eastside. Rumor has it that in the past two years, her services have helped many people get on the fast track to stardom.

The cosmetic surgeon, who is now sitting in front of you, doesn't strike you as a go-getter who has made it. This might be attributable to the fact that she has an aura of sullenness, which is accentuated by the way she talks and her general attitude.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I hear you can change your clients' faces according to their exact requirements. With the right price, they can get a perfect new face that will catapult them into stardom and change their lives forever.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: That's about the size of it. I have surgical skills, they have money. It's a two-way street. And it's fun to fulfill their so-called desire to advance with my hand.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's a legit business. Are you interested, Chief?

options: It's your clients that I'm interested in.

choices.text: It's your clients that I'm interested in.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: My clients? They get a ticket to success for a reasonable price. If you think about it, it's quite a bargain for them.
Uni runs her appraising eyes from your chin to your lips, and finally to your eyes.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's a win-win situation, really. I get paid, and my clients leave the clinic happy with their new looks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not all your clients, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Some of them didn't get to leave.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember seeing these people?
Uni gives the pictures a cursory glance before looking back up at you and replying in a casual tone.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I do. They were my clients. I met them only once or twice. But I haven't seen them since their cosmetic procedures.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The thing is, according to the witnesses, they were last seen on the day they went to your clinic. It seems that you were the last person they saw before they went missing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are they now?
You scrutinize her face, trying to pick up clues from her facial expressions.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: How should I know? I'm a cosmetic surgeon, not a brain surgeon. If I had the ability to control their brains—if they had ones, that is, I would've asked them to give me more money, instead of making them disappear.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I hope you're not accusing me of doing something unsavory during the procedures to make them disappear.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Well, you know, I had no reason to do that to them. We were basically strangers. Our relationship was purely business.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Unlike you, Chief, I don't have the means to make humans disappear without a trace. I'm just a humble cosmetic surgeon.

You reach out your hand. The shackles, glowing bright red, run out of your hand and latch onto Uni's wrist. As they make to reach deeper, they collide with another object, which gives out intense purple light upon impart.
The shackles bounce back. You almost lose balance. When you regain your footing, you look up and see Uni's strained face.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: So those are the fabled shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles only work on Sinners. An ordinary cosmetic surgeon might not be able to make humans disappear without anyone being any the wiser, but a Sinner can. And you are a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now tell me the truth. I'd hate to resort to any special means again in this interrogation.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Shackles, the good old shackles, the weapon of the powerful against us Sinners.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: (Sighs)
Uni's demeanor relaxes. She turns her gaze away from your face to a corner of the room. She seems to have lost all interest in you. What has brought about the change, you have no idea.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I beg your pardon?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I thought you'd be different. It turns out you're just like the rest of them.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You went to great lengths to track me down and bring me here to interrogate. But this is all just a charade, isn't it? You're gonna detain me no matter how this interrogation turns out. Simply because I'm a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: The moment we Sinners set foot in DisCity, we automatically become names on the most wanted list, and more often than not, we'll have some wrongdoing pinned on us.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: In your eyes, we are all criminals that should be put away. It doesn't matter which crime should be pinned on which Sinner, as long as it's a Sinner.

options: That's not what I'm doing here.
I have no intention of wronging you.

choices.text: That's not what I'm doing here.
I have no intention of wronging you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's my duty to track down Sinners. But I don't want to wrong anyone or accuse them of crimes they never committed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this case and find the missing persons, and get to know you as well.
The room falls silent. Uni turns to you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You want to know me?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: What are you, some kind of defender of justice?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, I'm not. It's just my principles.
Uni covers the lower half of her face with her gloved hand. It's only seconds later that you pick up the scornful look on her face.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Principles. Hahaha... That's interesting.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Chief, are you familiar with the story about a duckling who wants to become a swan?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: <size=30>Once upon a time, there was an ugly duckling who didn't fit in with the rest of the world. Time and again, she came to the edge of a lake to look at her reflection, hoping against hope that her feathers had grown thicker. Time and again, she was disappointed. She remained an ugly duckling.</size>

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: One day, the duckling saw a flock of swans flying past. She had never seen a creature so beautiful, so glamorous. It was at that moment that she decided that she didn't want to be a duckling anymore. She wanted to be an elegant swan.
As Uni tells the story, she conjures up blinking fragments of crystal above her fingertip, and manipulates them into different shapes to illustrate the story.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: She tried everything she could to become a swan but to no avail. To make matters worse, her feathers, once soft and clean, were now covered with grease.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Eventually, she gave up her dream of becoming a swan. Exhausted and crestfallen, she returned to the edge of the lake.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: She looked at her reflection. To her surprise, the duckling looking back at her wasn't dirty at all.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: She thought to herself, "Why didn't I think of this sooner? All I have to do is wash the grease off."

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Ecstatic, she dived into the lake in an attempt to wash off the grease, to become herself again...
A crystal duckling takes form above her fingertip and dives onto the tabletop. It vanishes on impact with a burst of light.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What happened next?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Well...

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: The duckling drowned, because she couldn't stay afloat, since her feathers were no longer waterproof due to the grease.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Let me ask you a question, Chief. What do you think was the culprit for the duckling's death, the grease that had accumulated in her feathers in her pursuit of beauty, or her greed for beauty?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you implying that the missing persons had it coming?
Uni gives a chuckle and raises her index finger. Light pools above the fingertip, and a round mirror decorated with symmetrical carvings materializes.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You said you wanted to know me. Here's your chance. I'm showing you my power.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: My mirror reveals the deepest desire of whoever looks into it, no matter how expertly they have hidden it out of sight.
You sense no hostility coming from the other end of the shackles. It should be safe to look in the mirror. Still, you have misgivings.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You have the shackles, and there are so many cameras here. So you can just relax. I'm not gonna try to hurt you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's normal to be scared of Mania. But do you know what's more scary?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Desires! Unsatisfied desires hidden deep inside every soul!
She runs her finger around the curved edge of the mirror frame in an intimate manner, just like her gaze at you right now.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Come, take a look. Maybe you'll find your missing persons in it.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Your missing persons looked in the mirror and saw their desires. You don't think there could be a clue or two in there for you?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: The DisCity's sun doesn't shine in this interrogation room, Chief. You'll have to prove yourself worthy of those clues first.
She spins the mirror slowly around to face you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Shall we, Chief?
The shackles tremble when you're about to come face to face with the mirror, which, without doubt, has been tainted with Mania.
But nothing out of the ordinary happens.
All you see in the mirror is your own reflection.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do people normally see in this mirror?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: A version of themselves that they desire to see. It's a reflection of their deepest desire, their deepest secret. They see the face they long for. And then I'll come in and make that face a reality.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: So do you like what you see?

Uni can't see what you're seeing in the mirror, yet her eyes growing more intense. When her fingers travel from the frame to the surface of the mirror, you have a strange feeling that it's your actual face that she's stroking.
Her uncomfortably intense gaze is filled with eager anticipation. What's she expecting?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry to disappoint you, but I only see my own reflection.
Almost instantly, all false expressions disappear from Uni's face. She watches your expression with unblinking eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there something wrong?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I found it...

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: A blank canvas. I've been right all along. You are the missing piece of my puzzle!
Uni's voice rises. A ripple breaks the smooth surface of the mirror, and the air in the room thickens, making it harder to breathe.
The shackles shake. Uni wraps her hands around the mirror frame, holding it so tightly that her fingertips go white. Her eyes bore into yours, and your eyes burn. Is this her power?!
The red shackles cut through the thick air, shatter the mirror, and confine Uni to her chair.
The scattered shards of glass reflect countless red stars, shining brightly in the dark room. For a moment, you catch sight of Uni's eyes through all the shards, greedy and covetous.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Hahaha...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What did you do?!

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's just my attempt to see how much superior you are to me, Honorable Leader versus Devious Trickster. Or you can think of it as a tentative attack.
Attack? Was that really an attack? It might have been, judging by your painful eyes and the bizarre way she was looking at you before her attack. She might be planning something.
A knock at the door interrupts your train of thought. Nightingale walks into the room, with a grim look on her face.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, a councilor is asking to speak with you, right now. It's about Uni the Sinner.
Nightingale shoots a glance at Uni, who responds with a smile.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Can't stand the thought of leaving me? It's okay. We'll meet again very soon.
MBCC Chief's Office

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: I wish I could, but my hands are tied.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Uni is irreplaceable. Her magic hands are a star-maker. And, as you must know, superstars attract investments and generate revenues!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You mean generate revenues for you?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Besides... think about our current situation. You're not just here to catch up with me, are you? Someone ordered you to find Carl's killer. Oh, and to apprehend the mastermind behind those three cases.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: <size=30>I'm hosting a function tonight. A lot of Eastside heavyweights are gonna be there. Come along and bring Uni with you. I'll introduce you to some of the guests. You have Sinners, and they have money; maybe you'll be able to get an investment deal or two out of them.</size>

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: That's settled then. See you tonight.
The councilor hung up, before you could have a chance to turn down the invitation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What do we do now, Chief?

options: I'll keep an eye on Uni myself.

choices.text: I'll keep an eye on Uni myself.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I see. And there's something else I want to tell you. While you were interrogating Uni, I found something that may be of interest to you.
Nightingale withdraws a photo from her file folder and hands it to you.
It's a photo of a young woman. She is smiling so brightly that for a second you fail to notice the uncanny resemblance between her and Uni.
Her name is Luna, Uni's twin sister. She went missing three years ago, but unlike the other missing persons, she never visited Uni's clinic.

<size=31>Luna worked as a model after she came of age. After she went missing, Uni, who was a student then, basically kept to herself, until two years ago, when she reappeared as a cosmetic surgeon. It was around this time that reports of missing persons started cropping up.</size>
Due to the long time gap, no connection was made between the two incidents in the initial documents. But are these two incidents really not connected?
And there's one more thing that's bothering you.
The moment when the shackles broke the mirror, you saw mirror fragments in the air angled towards Uni.
Yet in those broken pieces, her reflection was nowhere to be seen.
